verdict.line: You lose extended trades into her E-into-Q reset chain through the laning phase, but the matchup turns once your core items give you a health pool her burst can't punch through.

brief.thesis: Irelia's E (Flawless Duet) stun plus mark lets her chain straight into Bladesurge (Q) for a free reset and heal, so she repeatedly engages and disengages safely while Mundo has no CC to punish the dash. That structural gap is why Mundo only wins 43% of 193 recorded games here against a 50.4% average top-lane rate — the lane is hers, the matchup overall is not.

theirWindow.when: Her E and Q are both up
theirWindow.what: She stuns and marks you with Flawless Duet, then Bladesurge resets off the mark for a second free hit and heal. Don't stand near a low-health minion when she has both up — that's the engage OP.GG is warning about.

yourWindow.what: Walk up and throw Infected Cleaver (Q) freely, then lean on Burning Agony (W) in prolonged trades — without the stun she has no way to lock you down while it ticks.

start.why: Highest pick rate start (55.7% pick) — the extra early HP and sustain blunt her Bladesurge chip damage while you farm instead of trade.

boots.why: Best winrate boots (46.2% over 143 games) — flat damage reduction per hit directly undercuts her stacking Ionian Fervor on-hit damage.

core.why: Stacking HP scales your Infected Cleaver's max-health damage and starts building the health pool her dash poke can't punch through.
Matches the highest-winrate measured core path (57.1% over 7 games) — the regen threshold keeps you topped off between her engages.
Completes the measured core build, adding sustained wave damage and more max-health scaling for extended trades.

she is auto-attacking you down early before your core items finish

you need to dodge her E/Q engage range instead of trading hits

runes.keystoneWhy: Periodic healing and permanent HP stacking reward you for soaking her pokes and dash hits instead of needing to win the trade outright.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport posts the best measured winrate of the three combos (47.7%) — Flash dodges the Flawless Duet convergence, Teleport recovers any CS lost to her dash resets.

playing.title: Farm, don't trade
playing.detail: Infected Cleaver (Q, 4s cooldown, 975 range) scales off her max health and chips her for free from outside Flawless Duet's 850 range — prioritize CS over forcing fights.

playing.title: Track her E cooldown
playing.detail: Flawless Duet is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s depending on rank — once she lands or whiffs it, that stun/mark window is gone for the full duration, and that's your cue to step in.

playing.title: Respect low-HP minions near her
playing.detail: Bladesurge instantly refreshes its cooldown if it kills a Marked or near-dead target, so never leave a dying minion next to you while her Q is up.

playing.title: Toggle W into her stun
playing.detail: Burning Agony (W, 1s cooldown, 325 range) drains your own health but shortens disable duration — turn it on as her E lands to cut the stun short and punish the follow-up.

playing.title: Trade when already hurt
playing.detail: Masochism (E, 7s cooldown) scales your bonus AD off missing health, so a fight at 60% HP hits harder than one at full — don't play passive just because your bar is low.

playing.title: Save R for all-ins, not poke
playing.detail: Sadism (R, 75s cooldown) only trades health for move speed and regen — hold it for committed skirmishes or to run down/escape a dive, not routine lane cooldowns.

playing.title: Build into her passive
playing.detail: Ionian Fervor stacks attack speed and adds bonus on-hit damage at max stacks — Thornmail and Bramble Vest directly punish her once she leans on auto-attacks.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the cooldown-window and trade-pattern reasoning is my own analysis, not sourced data.
